'''0.23g''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that changed [[factions|faction]] loyalty to not reset after failing a quest.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Mission failure results in [[Factions|faction]] loyalty drop by 10%, instead of complete zeroing
* Task accomplishment mechanism for "win with no containers stolen by the enemy" fixed
* The level of ammunition applied is taken into account in match-making
* Spam filter for messages in public chat channels added

===Item properties change===
* [[AKM]] damage increased from 42 to 45

===User Interface===
* Kill indicator re-enabled, with an option to disable in options. Now the kill indicator works with the delay equal to your ping rate to ensure less false notifications

===Bug Fixes===
* Some texture streaming bugs fixed
* Automatic match-making cancellation bug fixed
* Temporary lobby-server inaccessibility bug fixed
* Server performance considerably improved, in-game lags caused by game server overload reduced
* Bug causing some players not to receive the message about the match start and not letting them into the match fixed
